name: verticalbar-agent
description: VerticalBar Agent for Claude Code: author and publish self-contained, on-brand HTML analysis artifacts grounded in CrossCheck and Vertical Bar data, over a local stdio MCP server. Includes a governed deployment-mutation exception for workspace-scoped release-package and workflow tools (create/add require deploy:write; start-run additionally requires an identified Cognito user via OAuth or SRP; no API key can start a run; no approval capability); talks to CrossCheck only over HTTP. Does not replace Claude Code's agent, model, or permissions.
